summary: The Ansible plug-in dashboard in RHDH has Overview, Learn (curated resources), Discover existing collections (private or console automation hub), Create (new SCM projects), Develop (OpenShift Dev Spaces) and Operate (link to AAP to run jobs).
questions: What is on the Ansible plug-in dashboard?
